title: Review and export a synthetic case
scenario: Scenario: reviewed-cases / workflow-map. Candidate based on main 48b854b, captured 2026-10-18. Use Python 3.11+, a disposable home, selected task feedback and explicitly supplied synthetic inputs. No model call is required.

steps.title: Inspect the case boundary
steps.instruction: Open docs/map/workflow.html and choose 2. Case / reviewed export. Expand its details. Follow Sources to the improvement design and the authoritative observation guide for cases.py request fields.
steps.caption: Actual map dialog: explicit case export is implemented; automatic triage and model evaluation remain planned.
steps.expected: A case binds one task revision and selected correction feedback. Supply the synthetic reproduction, outcome contract and successful or contrary counterpart yourself.

steps.title: Review exact bytes, export, then revoke
steps.instruction: Run prepare --task with the selected revision, feedback IDs and synthetic payload, then show --task --case. Inspect every field and the counterpart. Review the exact digest with both confirmation flags; export to a new absolute path. Revoke the grant after the disposable check.
steps.caption: Selected results of actual English/Korean positive and adjacent-negative CLI runs, rendered in a browser. Not a terminal screenshot or live efficacy result.
steps.expected: Missing correction stays insufficient and export before review is refused. Export contains only synthetic development fields and hashes. Revoke purges private lineage and blocks later export; already detached synthetic artifacts remain.
